# Noto Emoji (subset)

- Upstream: https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji, tag `v2.051` (see `VERSION`).
- Files: `svg/emoji_u*.svg`, copied unchanged from `svg/` at that tag, only the codepoints listed in
